title: DAgger twins on validation: iterations 19, 39 and 59 of net2 (r25-means) and neto2 (r26), 29 policies
description: exp-dagger-twins-val-255 compared round 25's DAgger students on net1 v9's means (net2) with round 26's on neto1 v2 (neto2, the same recipe, rule teacher at u = 0.25 or 0.375) after iteration 39, an iteration fixed beforehand, and one neto2 seed had dipped there during training. Before any claim the iteration is chosen on validation, for both sides alike: this run evaluates every training seed of r25-means, r26-u0.25 and r26-u0.375 after iterations 19, 39 and 59 (27 policies, named ARM-iN-sSEED), beside BBRv3 and, as reference lines only, the rule on net1 v9 at u = 0.25 (rule-v9) and on neto1 v2 at u = 0.375 (rule-v2), on the five validation families and as 2 and 4 copies, campaign seed 21 as in releases 253 and 255. Each arm's iteration is then the one with the best mean over its three training seeds on the five families; the chosen arms are confirmed at campaign seeds 11 and 31 before a single test run. The policies come from small model releases: model-net2-r25 (iterations 39 and 59), model-neto2-r26 (iteration 39) and model-dagger-twins-i19-i59 (round 25's iteration 19, round 26's iterations 19 and 59), copied unchanged from exp-net2-r25-v9-249 and exp-neto2-r26-v2-254. Validation links only; no claim about the test links.
prepare: N9="$IN/v9/$(cat "$IN/v9/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; N2="$IN/v2/$(cat "$IN/v2/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v9" "$N9" --u 0.25; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v2" "$N2" --u 0.375; P=(--policy "rule-v9=$OUT/v9/rule-u0.25.onnx" --policy "rule-v2=$OUT/v2/rule-u0.375.onnx"); for d in r q x; do (cd "$IN/$d" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); done; for f in "$IN"/r/ppo-r25-means-*-i39.onnx "$IN"/r/ppo-r25-means-*-i59.onnx "$IN"/q/ppo-r26-*-i39.onnx "$IN"/x/ppo-*.onnx; do n="$(basename "$f" .onnx)"; n="${n#ppo-}"; it="${n##*-}"; b="${n%-*}"; P+=(--policy "${b%-*}-$it-${b##*-}=$f"); done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 58 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart copies-30s --best r25-means-i19 r25-means-i39 r25-means-i59 r26-u0.25-i19 r26-u0.25-i39 r26-u0.25-i59 r26-u0.375-i19 r26-u0.375-i39 r26-u0.375-i59 && uv run python experiments/versus_rule.py "$OUT" rule-v9
